name: agents
description: An AI-agent kit: skills for working with Claude Code agents, with more kinds to come.

plugins.name: todo-sync
plugins.description: Keeps each session's todo list complete in its own file, and rebuilds it from the session's transcript when it goes missing or comes back short.

plugins.name: checkpoint
plugins.description: Brings a session's work to a safe stopping point before a restart, records exactly where it stands, and resumes from that record afterwards.

plugins.name: away-loop
plugins.description: Keeps a session working, visibly, while you are away for hours: a 30-minute wake-up, minor decisions logged, questions queued, one summary when you return.

plugins.name: crossfire
plugins.description: Reviews a plan, design doc, pull request or open decision before you build it, with independent read-only reviewers, a verifier for every blocker, and a fixed gate.

plugins.name: on-loop
plugins.description: Keeps a session working a project's roadmap while you come and go: one item at a time on its own branches, each decision logged with an exact undo for you to keep, change or veto.
